column1: > Every rule this layer's contract states, and what proves it. Full accounting,
> never full coverage: a rule no sequence of driver operations can detect says
> so here with its reason, and a rule nothing implements yet says that.
>   <tag>  <the rule>  <scenario ... | untestable: why | not built: why>
> The scenarios beside this file are read by config/go/corpus_test.go and by
> config/python/test_corpus.py; each language's transcript is compared with the
> recorded .expected byte for byte, so the two languages agree through it.

column2: the nearer rung wins: run over user over machine
a site rung is reserved and absent
column3: untestable: an absent rung answers nothing, so no operation tells "reserved" from "never thought of"

column2: a farther rung may lock a key against a nearer one
column3: not built: no rung can lock a key yet, so there is nothing to reach

column2: every answer carries provenance per key: a rung and a path, or environment, or default
column3: nothing user-file environment-over-user provenance-is-per-key off-carries-provenance malformed-is-said

column2: the path half of provenance names the file that answered
column3: untestable: a path is one machine's, so no transcript two machines compare can carry it; held by config/go/config_test.go and config/python/test_abstraction_config.py

column2: the machine rung is read only when an administrator owns the file and its directory, and an untrusted file is ignored rather than obeyed
an ignored file is said on stderr, never silently
a machine file an administrator did own is read
column3: untestable: a driver running as an ordinary user cannot make a root- or Administrators-owned fixture, and the rule under test is what stops it reading its own

column2: a write to the machine rung that no reader would trust is refused, and leaves nothing behind
column3: untestable: the corpus is one transcript both languages print and only the Go half of this layer writes; held by config/go/trust_test.go, which says UNPROVEN on stderr where the machine rung is /etc

column2: the environment is an override for one run, and an empty variable is not one
a value taken from the environment is never observed to change
column3: untestable: an absence, and no sequence of calls can observe a notice that is never sent

column2: a subscription reports the answer when it differs, from whichever process wrote it, and names its mechanism
column3: untestable: the notice is judged over wall time and across processes, which a transcript compared byte for byte cannot carry; held by config/go/watch_test.go and config/python/test_abstraction_config.py. The comparison it leaves to the client is CFG-W2, and that half a transcript does carry

column2: the stamp follows the answer, not the rung that gave it
a key the schema does not name is refused, not ignored
column3: not built: nothing refuses an unknown key yet; both implementations ignore one today

column2: no secret and no policy is a setting
column3: untestable: a rule about what may be added to the schema, not about any answer
